create_greedy_policy: create a GreedyPolicy instance from a game, player ids, and a state-action value function
build_action_probabilities: build action probabilities dict that assigns probability 1.0 to the highest-value legal action
run_greedy_action: run the greedy policy to select the single best legal action for a given state
test_greedy_policy: test the GreedyPolicy class that computes a greedy policy from a value function
review_action_method: review the action method that returns the argmax legal action based on state-action values
